Version: 0.9.5-debian-devices.1
Source commit: f6f3ba52d86cd43bc000c72254ce7345697e7f2f
Target: Linux amd64, Go 1.24.1, CGO_ENABLED=0, statically linked, stripped.

Features:
- Separate device credentials retain the real account UID for traffic accounting.
- Per-node active-stream registry reports devices sharing an IP independently.
- Revocation closes existing streams and rejects cached authentication.
- Managed profiles expire their cached permission after max(120, 3*UpdatePeriodic)
  seconds without successful sync (304 extends it), checked at 5-second intervals.
- Legacy accounts keep their existing outage policy; manual custom inbounds are not controlled.
- Revoked profile traffic is retained for final reporting and quiet counters are released.
- Traffic acknowledgements subtract the reported snapshot without losing bytes arriving during API calls.

Verification:
- All modules verified against go.sum.
- Registry/limiter/SSPanel/controller tests passed with the race detector.
- Existing selected TLS helper and inbound builder tests passed.
- Integration with real VLESS clients and the packaged binary passed: two profiles
  behind the same IP, selective termination, continued payload transfer on the other
  profile, full-account termination, and final traffic reporting to the owner.
- 13 bootstrap/installer/upgrade fixture tests passed; checksums checked.
- Paired DPanel branch has MariaDB migration/authorization/subscription/presence tests.
- Not deployed on production web/node; no WAN throughput or real kernel change tested here.
